scope_notes: Coordinator-sanctioned scope addition: apps/web/src/pages/Home.module.css and apps/web/src/pages/Workspace.module.css are companion CSS Modules required by the owned page components (P2-F3). Round-2 revisions address: honest PDF validation without fabricated findings (P1), Home page 360px viewport overflow fix (P2), degenerate JSON validation and ErrorBoundary protection (P2).

Click/keyboard finding selects correct d.detail: Verified by Playwright test (tests/browser/viewer.spec.ts: criterion 1) and CanvasOverlay / ViewerStage implementation. Tests that zoom (150%) and 90° clockwise rotation preserve exact canonical coordinate transformation. Selecting finding finding-dup-2 targets the second duplicate occurrence ("$1,000.00", occ-p0-dup2, page 0, ordinal 2) with exact coordinate highlight (#highlight-occ-p0-dup2), displaying ordinal and page in the EvidenceSlip. Keyboard navigation (N/P cycling and Enter on focused finding item) selects and navigates without string-search ambiguity (Invariant I04, P3-F4).

two views sync without scroll loop.detail: Verified by Playwright test (tests/browser/viewer.spec.ts: criterion 2) and ComparePanes implementation. In compare mode with side-by-side viewports (#compare-pane-left and #compare-pane-right), scrolling pane A to 120px triggers synchronized scrolling on pane B. Scrolling pane B back to 30px updates pane A without recursive scroll feedback or jitter via requestAnimationFrame loop breaker (Invariant I07).

narrow screen stacks instead of squeezin.detail: Verified by Playwright test (tests/browser/viewer.spec.ts: criterion 3) and ComparePanes / Workspace responsive styles. When viewport width is resized to 360px (< 768px threshold), compare panes switch from side-by-side row layout to stacked column layout (#compare-panes.stacked), with both left and right panes maintaining full readable widths (>= 280px). Toolbar and documentBar wrap cleanly with zero horizontal document overflow (scrollWidth <= clientWidth, P2-F2).

unknown geometry stays page-level.detail: Verified by Playwright test (tests/browser/viewer.spec.ts: criterion 4) and CanvasOverlay / ViewerStage implementation. For findings with geometry.precision: "page_only" | "unknown" (finding-page1-unknown), navigating to Page 2 renders #page-level-geometry-notice with text explaining the finding applies to the page as a whole because localized coordinates are unavailable. Asserts 0 fabricated coordinate highlight boxes are drawn on the canvas (Invariant I02).

canvas has equivalent reachable content.detail: Verified by Playwright test (tests/browser/viewer.spec.ts: criterion 5), AccessibleTextLayer implementation, and automated axe-core accessibility audit. The accessible text layer (#accessible-text-equivalent) provides a non-visual DOM equivalent carrying all page text occurrences with ordinals, timestamps, and published reader limits per Invariant I14 / ACCESSIBILITY.md row A02. Automated WCAG 2.2 AA audit across tags wcag2a, wcag2aa, wcag21a, wcag21aa, and wcag22aa returns 0 serious or critical violations.
